g.title: QtToPython
g.text: From Qt's C++ to your Python: every piece
read from the top: C++ first, your program last

g.title: cluster_ours
g.text: OURS (C++), built once, before anything runs

g.title: qtsrc
g.text: turned into the two boxes below by
whoever packaged Qt for your system

g.title: qthdr
g.text: every class, function and attribute, by name
only a C++ compiler can read them

g.title: cpp
g.text: today: rituals.cpp later: one file per Qt class
one small, plainly named function per Qt function

g.title: gpp
g.text: -l which Qt files ours leans on

g.title: objs
g.text: each lives at an address, in the memory

g.title: ctypes
g.text: opens a shared object, finds a function by name,
hands numbers over and gets a number back

g.title: ourso->ctypes
g.text: opens the file, then runs one function

g.title: ugly
g.text: holds the address of one C++ object
the only code that touches ctypes

g.title: ctypes->ugly
g.text: a function's name, plus the address

g.title: cute
g.text: plain Python; uglySide is built on first read

g.title: meta
g.text: and knows which one offers a name

g.title: legend
g.text: made from: happens once, before anything runs
a call, while your program runs
a program that does a job and exits

g.title: later
g.text: NOT BUILT YET: the other direction
Qt's C++ calling into your Python,
